posts.title: Software Engineering is the new Manufacturing Engineering
posts.description: LLMs are regression-to-the-mean machines--they pull junior developers up, and drag senior developers down. Taming them requires trading the romance of 'code as craft' for the physics of manufacturing.

posts.title: Plans as Version Control Artifacts
posts.description: TL;DR : In plan-oriented programming, the plan is the primary artifact--reviewed, debated, and validated by humans, AI agents, designers, and PMs before any code is written . By storing plans as Jujutsu change descriptions (note: jj is a VCS, like git ), they become permanent, addressable nodes in version history.

posts.title: Loro Extended, or, Why I get excited about CRDTs
posts.description: Author's Update: Since this post, I've dedicated my time to a successor project that improves upon Loro Extended called Kyneta . A deep dive into distributed systems, local-first software, and the future of collaborative applications. A mock interview about Loro Extended , the state sync typescript library.
